47361-warwickshire-the-land-of-shakespea.title: Warwickshire The Land Of Shakespeare
47361-warwickshire-the-land-of-shakespea.creator: Unknown
47361-warwickshire-the-land-of-shakespea.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Warwickshire has rightly been termed “leafy Warwickshire,” for although deficient in scenery cast in a large mould, which may be described as grand or magnificent, it is undoubtedly one of the most lovely of English counties. Though lacking the peaks and deep–set dales of its near neighbour, Derbyshire, which it touches at its northern limit, it is essentially a county of pleasant hills, uplands, and fertile well–watered vales.

arxiv-1911-02499.title: Dimensional Emotion Detection from Categorical Emotion
arxiv-1911-02499.creator: Sungjoon Park Jiseon Kim Seonghyeon Ye Jaeyeol Jeon Hee Young Park Alice Oh
arxiv-1911-02499.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Sungjoon Park Jiseon Kim Seonghyeon Ye Jaeyeol Jeon Hee Young Park Alice Oh. We present a model to predict fine-grained emotions along the continuous dimensions of valence, arousal, and dominance (VAD) with a corpus with categorical emotion annotations. Our model is trained by minimizing the EMD (Earth Mover’s Distance) loss between the predicted VAD score distribution and the categorical emotion distributions sorted along VAD, and it can simultaneously classify the emotion categories and predict the VAD scores for a given sentence.

arxiv-2101-08240.title: Renormalization group improved pressure for hot and dense quark matter
arxiv-2101-08240.creator: Jean-Loïc Kneur, Marcus Benghi Pinto, Tulio E. Restrepo
arxiv-2101-08240.description: Abstract We apply the renormalization group optimized perturbation theory (RGOPT) to evaluate the quark contribution to the QCD pressure at finite temperatures and baryonic densities, at next-to-leading order (NLO). Our results are compared to NLO and state-of-the-art higher orders of standard perturbative QCD (pQCD) and hard thermal loop perturbation theory (HTLpt).

arxiv-2205-12147.title: Multi-ring images of thin accretion disk of a regular naked compact object
arxiv-2205-12147.creator: Merce Guerrero, Gonzalo J. Olmo, Diego Rubiera-Garcia, Diego Sáez-Chillón Gómez
arxiv-2205-12147.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Merce Guerrero, Gonzalo J. Olmo, Diego Rubiera-Garcia, Diego Sáez-Chillón Gómez. We discuss the importance of multi-ring images in the optical appearance of a horizonless spherically symmetric compact object, when illuminated by an optically thin accretion disk.

arxiv-2302-04124.title: An extended Gauss-Newton method for full waveform inversion
arxiv-2302-04124.creator: Ali Gholami
arxiv-2302-04124.description: Abstract Full waveform inversion (FWI) is a large-scale nonlinear ill-posed problem for which computationally expensive Newton-type methods can become trapped in undesirable local minima, particularly when the initial model lacks a low-wavenumber component and the recorded data lacks low-frequency content. A modification to the Gauss-Newton (GN) method is proposed to address these issues.

arxiv-2303-04514.title: Lidstone interpolation
arxiv-2303-04514.creator: I. One variable
arxiv-2303-04514.description: Abstract Update: August 7, 2026 The Mathematics Student , February 2022. Proceedings of the 87th Annual Conference of the Indian Mathematical Society, December 2021. Abstract According to Lidstone interpolation theory, an entire function of exponential type <\pi is determined by it derivatives of even order at 0 and 1 . This theory can be generalized to several variables.

arxiv-2409-02548.title: A Joint Time and Energy-Efficient Federated Learning-based Computation Offloading Method for Mobile Edge Computing
arxiv-2409-02548.creator: Anwesha Mukherjee, Rajkumar Buyya
arxiv-2409-02548.description: Abstract Computation offloading at lower time and lower energy consumption is crucial for resource limited mobile devices. This paper proposes an offloading decision-making model using federated learning. Based on the task type and the user input, the proposed decision-making model predicts whether the task is computationally intensive or not.

arxiv-2411-04174.title: New classes of quantum anomalous Hall crystals in multilayer graphene
arxiv-2411-04174.creator: Boran Zhou, Ya-Hui Zhang
arxiv-2411-04174.description: Abstract The recent experimental observation of quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) effects in the rhombohedrally stacked pentalayer graphene has motivated theoretical discussions on the possibility of quantum anomalous Hall crystal (QAHC), a topological version of Wigner crystal. Conventionally Wigner crystal was assumed to have a period a crystal = 1 / n a_{\text{crystal}}=1/\sqrt{n} locked to the density n n .

arxiv-2411-07526.title: QR Sort: A Novel Non-Comparative Sorting Algorithm
arxiv-2411-07526.creator: Randolph T. Bushman, Tanya M. Tebcherani, Alhassan S. Yasin
arxiv-2411-07526.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Randolph T. Bushman, Tanya M. Tebcherani, Alhassan S. Yasin. In this paper, we introduce and prove QR Sort, a novel non-comparative integer sorting algorithm. This algorithm uses principles derived from the Quotient-Remainder Theorem and Counting Sort subroutines to sort input sequences stably.

arxiv-2508-12040.title: Mind the Generation Process: Fine-Grained Confidence Estimation During LLM Generation
arxiv-2508-12040.creator: Jinyi Han, Tingyun li, Shisong Chen, Jie shi, Xinyi Wang, Guanglei Yue, Jiaqing Liang, Xin Lin, Liqian Wen, Zulong Chen, Yanghua Xiao
arxiv-2508-12040.description: Abstract While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across diverse tasks, they fundamentally lack self-awareness and frequently exhibit overconfidence, assigning high confidence scores to incorrect predictions. Accurate confidence estimation is therefore critical for enhancing the trustworthiness and reliability of LLM-generated outputs.

arxiv-2510-11334.title: Exponential convergence of multiagent systems with lack of connection
arxiv-2510-11334.creator: Fabio Ancona, Mohamed Bentaibi, Francesco Rossi
arxiv-2510-11334.description: Abstract Finding conditions ensuring consensus, i.e. convergence to a common value, for a networked system is of crucial interest, both for theoretical reasons and applications. This goal is harder to achieve when connections between agents are temporarily lost. Here, we prove that known conditions (introduced by Moreau) ensure an exponential convergence to consensus, with explicit rate of convergence.

arxiv-2512-04525.title: Continuously tunable single-photon level nonlinearity with Rydberg state wave-function engineering
arxiv-2512-04525.creator: Biao Xu, Gen-Sheng Ye, Yue Chang, Tao Shi, Lin Li
arxiv-2512-04525.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Biao Xu, Gen-Sheng Ye, Yue Chang, Tao Shi, Lin Li. Extending optical nonlinearity into the extremely weak light regime is at the heart of quantum optics, since it enables the efficient generation of photonic entanglement and implementation of photonic quantum logic gate. Here, we demonstrate the capability for continuously tunable single-photon level nonlinearity, enabled by precise control of Rydberg interaction over two orders of magnitude, through the use of microwave-assisted wave-function engineering.

pmc-11599293.title: Family history of dementia and brain health in childhood and middle age: a prospective community-based study
pmc-11599293.creator: Rowina F Hussainali, Isabel K Schuurmans, Jendé L Zijlmans, Charlotte A M Cecil, Meike W Vernooij, Annemarie I Luik, Ryan L Muetzel, M Arfan Ikram, Frank J Wolters
pmc-11599293.description: We aimed to determine the association of family history of dementia with structural brain measures and cognitive performance in childhood and mid-life adulthood. We studied 1,259 parents (mean age: 47.3 years, range 31.9–67.4) and 866 of their children (mean age [range] at brain MRI: 9.9 years [8.8–11.9], and for cognition: 13.5 years [12.6–15.8]) of the population-based Generation R Study.

pmc-11691818.title: PLASMA PROTEIN BIOMARKERS AND THEIR CORRELATION TO COGNITIVE PERFORMANCE IN WOMEN LIVING WITH HIV
pmc-11691818.creator: Wei Li, Ge Wang, David Vance, Daniel Li
pmc-11691818.description: BackgroundIndividual plasma protein biomarkers have been shown to correlate to cognitive performance in people with HIV (PWH). This study aimed to investigate the association between plasma proteomic signatures and cognition in virologically well-controlled women with HIV (WWH). MethodsSeventy-seven WWH from three Women’s Interagency HIV Study (WIHS) sites completed neuropsychological (NP) testing and a blood draw.

pmc-12428464.title: Integrative Analysis of Fungal and Bacterial Microbiomes Across Skin, Blood, and Stool in Rosacea Patients
pmc-12428464.creator: Marie Isolde Joura, Éva Nemes-Nikodém, Antal Jobbágy, Zsuzsanna A Dunai, Nóra Makra, András Bánvölgyi, Norbert Kiss, Miklós Sárdy, Sarolta Eszter Sándor, Péter Holló, Eszter Ostorházi, Terenzio Cosio
pmc-12428464.description: Rosacea is a chronic inflammatory skin disorder with multifactorial pathogenesis involving immune dysregulation and microbial alterations. This study compared the mycobiomes of skin, blood, and stool samples in rosacea patients and healthy controls to assess fungal diversity, abundance, and possible translocation, as well as associations with bacterial microbiomes.

pmc-12635666.creator: Yu-Qing Zhou, Wen-Jing Xu, Yu-Ling Yang, Hui Su, Hui Lu, Hui Yu, Jing Wang, Ling Li, Dan-Hua Liang, Yong-Ping Xu, Jing-Fang Xia, Ying Chen, Rui-Rong Wu
pmc-12635666.description: BACKGROUNDStudies have shown that locomotive syndrome (LS) is significantly correlated with adverse outcomes, such as decreased self-care abilities, fractures, and increased mortality. Subthreshold depression (StD) is considered an independent predictor of clinical depression, regarded as its prodromal stage, and even linked to increased mortality risk.

pmc-13072761.title: Assessment of Interleukin-6 (IL-6) and Cotinine Levels in the Saliva of Patients with Precancerous Lesions and Oral Mucosa Cancer
pmc-13072761.creator: Iwona Niedzielska, Jacek Kasperski, Karolina Pałkiewicz-Gierka, Barbara Trepka-Sirek, Zbigniew Puszczewicz
pmc-13072761.description: Background/Objectives: Oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) and oral potentially malignant disorders (OPMDs) remain major clinical challenges due to late diagnosis and limited prognostic markers. This study evaluated salivary interleukin-6 (IL-6) and cotinine as potential biomarkers for oral epithelial transformation and exposure to risk factors.
